title: Presenting architecture to technical and non-technical audiences

videos.script: The review was over. Fourteen risks, one theme, one decision taken. Now three rooms had to hear about it in one week. {{title}} On Monday, the directors. On Wednesday, product. On Thursday, forty engineers. The same model, and three different presentations. {{rooms}} This lesson is about the part of a presentation that is the architect's own. Which view goes to which room. How to walk a diagram so people follow it. How to show what changes. {{walk}} How to put a risk in front of somebody with the number it rests on. And how to draw a slide that the back row can read. {{readable}} It is also the last lesson of the course. So it ends with what you can now do, and with what comes next in the track.
